text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah didn't seem to be feeling 
well, so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...I apologize for causing trouble.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Where on earth is this...? I'm sure I 
was sleeping in the infirmary—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Let's! Celebrity☆Disco Night~♪

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Phew~♪

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: E-Everyone?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Meji-senpai! Come dance with me too, 
Meji-senpai~♡

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Um... why are you dancing?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "That's 'cause this is a magical disco!♪"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Of magic?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yes! My ultimate magic spell! "Kali 
Lilirica Flower"!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
When this spell takes hold, your spirits 
soar and you just can't help letting 
loose♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Messiah! Don't you wanna just cut loose 
and go wild every once in a while?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Right on! Let's make a big, gorgeous 
splash together~♡

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Blossoming brilliantly... Me too...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Geez! Stop dawdling! Here! 
『Curri-Lilica-Flower』☆"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: There, there, there, there...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
My! How utterly wonderful! May I join in 
the dance as well?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... This is so fun. It feels just like 
a dream...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I can't lose either! ...Let's settle this, 
Messiah!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —Yes!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...A dream.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Even if it was just a dream, I 
really let loose quite a bit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to a pleasant dream, Air Messiah 
felt completely refreshed.
